title: Shaping Austin: Civic Center, Jail, Litigation
summary:
*   **Future Civic Center Plans:** The city moved forward with plans to solicit development proposals from landowners for a new Civic Center.
*   **Jail Facility Merger Talks:** Discussions continued regarding a potential agreement with Travis County to consolidate city and county jail facilities.
*   **Top Leadership Search:** An executive session was held to discuss the ongoing search for a new City Manager.
*   **Major Legal Battles:** Council reviewed ongoing litigation, including significant cases related to water rates and energy companies.

BOARD & COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS
The Council, on Councilmember Humphrey's motion, Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's second,
appointed Walter W. Brown as a member of the Planning Commission. (5-0 Vote, Mayor Pro Tem
Trevino and Councilmember Urdy absent) The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's
motion, Councilmember Humphrey's second, appointed Karen Belton as a member of the Austin
"150" Committee. (5-0 Vote, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino and Councilmember Urdy absent)
ITEM CONTINUED
Continued to January 14, 1988 is consideration of entering into an Interlocal Agreement
with Travis County to provide for the consolidation of City and County jail facilities.
AIRPORT ANNEXATION ISSUES Norman Standerfer and Karen Walz reported to Council concerning
airport annexation issues.
CIVIC CENTER DEVELOPMENT PROPOSALS
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Nofziger's second,
adopted a resolution approving the issuance of Request for Proposals to solicit Civic
Center development proposals from landowners within the districts under consideration for
site selection. (Recommended by Gilbane Building Company)
